scientific_integrity: Analytic finite-n proof and gamma scaling; exact-rational reproducibility checks are supporting evidence, not a substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: Uniform i.i.d. samples on a fixed circle only, conditional on two acute angles
The n=4 adjacent-angle joint density is implied by the published quadrilateral tent density; no priority asserted for that specialization
An older general-n conditional angle-pair law might remain undiscovered; independent review not performed
title: Conditional joint shape of the two acute angles in a random cyclic polygon
